newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: At least 20 ships wait off Karachi port.
newsitem.headline: At least 20 ships wait off Karachi port.

text.p: Pakistani cargo agents said on Tuesday at least 20 ships, including one which arrived on September 22, were waiting off Karachi Port.
A spokesman for the port said the vessels had not been listed as awaiting berths for various reasons, including delays in preparing shipping papers.
The ships included five vessels carrying 59,505 tonnes of sugar, one agent said.
One port official said 12 ships were waiting off the port and eight near the port.
